name: Ashdod

queries.query: Ashdod Israel official cadastral parcel map GIS API
queries.result: Found the first-party Ashdod municipal ArcGIS REST directory, including a parcel/block service (גושים_וחלקות) and a municipal engineering/GIS route. The parcel layer exposed public query access and returned a bounded polygon response.

queries.query: אשדוד מפת גושים חלקות кадаסטר GIS parcel official
queries.result: מצאתי את ספריית ה-REST הרשמית של עיריית אשדוד ואת שירות גושים וחלקות; שכבת החלקות זמינה לשאילתה ציבורית אנונימית ומחזירה גיאומטריית פוליגון ושדות זיהוי גוש/חלקה.

registryEvidence.custodian: Ashdod Municipality, Engineering Administration / municipal GIS
registryEvidence.basis: The first-party municipal GIS REST directory publishes the גושים וחלקות (blocks and parcels) MapServer and the municipal engineering page links the city GIS service.

officialSources.observation: Official Ashdod municipal ArcGIS MapServer with block-boundary and parcel layers; service CRS is EPSG:2039 and parcel layer supports Query with GeoJSON output.

requests.outcome: Fetched official ArcGIS REST service directory; identified גושים_וחלקות/MapServer.
Inspected service metadata: extent EPSG:2039; layers 0 block boundaries and 1 parcel layer.
Inspected parcel schema. Native fields include OBJECTID, Helka (parcel), Gush (block), Helka_Area and geometry; only safe ID/geometry fields were used.

Anonymous point-intersects query at the exact WUP point transformed to EPSG:2039 (166954.572, 634134.164) returned one Polygon: native OBJECTID 6473, Gush 2068, Helka 199. Response GeoJSON coordinates are WGS84 longitude/latitude. Full raw response retained only under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/285/exact.geojson.
Inspected related municipal map service; it exposed planning/building layers but was not used for parcel geometry.

source: Ashdod municipal ArcGIS REST גושים_וחלקות/MapServer layer 1

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Exact-point anonymous query returned one parcel polygon; this is local point evidence, not a complete citywide extract.

remainingUncertainty: The public municipal route and exact-point geometry are verified, but this bounded query does not establish complete citywide coverage, update cadence, or adapter robustness. A retained sample was not written because the full unchanged polygon was kept only in ignored temporary evidence; no coordinate was shifted to force a hit.
